liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He's Gone** (3 reviews): Reportedly played for Rock Scully, giving the ending an unusual treatment; The end of He's Gone is among the trippiest the reviewer has heard [15][25][26]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (2 reviews): Brent shines on Minglewood, a highlight along with parts of Fire; Reviewer's personal favorite Minglewood version [18][20]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Scarlet into Fire is beautiful; The Scarlet into Fire sequence is a standout [19][26]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (1 review): Reviewer calls this one of the best Dupree's versions ever [20]
- **Althea** (1 review): Jerry's delivery of the line about laying your head is singled out in Althea [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-03-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105821.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-03-31.148339.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1984-03-31.sonyecm.andrewf.29916.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min [5]. Said about its sound: The first notes of Minglewood are clipped, and ambient speakers affect the vocals in Dupree's, Deal and most of set two [5]
- **gd1984-03-31.177920.schoeps.mk4.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 164 min [6]
- **gd84-03-31.sbd.nawrocki.14078.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 29 [12]. Said about its sound: Complete, uncut, crisp soundboard seed, though the encore is missing; Crystal clear quality; Sound quality is terrific [17][19][20][23][26]
- **gd84-03-31.sbd.lai.2576.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 135 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [14]. Said about its sound: This copy's Fire on the Mountain cuts out in the first chorus, with a smaller cut in He's Gone's vocal jam [16]

## Around the show

- Rock Scully was reportedly forced out of the organization during these shows [15]
- Relaxed, inventive performance that conveys the intimacy of the hall [17]
- Rates the whole Marin run, 3/28 to 4/1, very highly; compares Brent's psychedelic sounds to the 5/84 Hult shows [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-03-31.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105821.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5/Maxell XLIIS-90) [1]. Also: Soundboard source credited to Joani Walker and Paul Scotton, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1984-03-31.148339.fob.akg.d330bt.senn421.hecht.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Chris Hecht; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Chris Hecht's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; (2) AKG D330BT mics + (1) Sennheiser 421 > Fostex Mixer > Sony D5M [3]. Also: A Sony ECM220t FOB source supplies the first 11 seconds of Althea; A Beyer M160/Sennheiser 421 source supplies a 9:49 patch in Drums [3]
- **gd1984-03-31.sonyecm.andrewf.29916.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F.; source: Sony ECM-939LT stereo mics (x2) > Marantz PMD-340 cassette deck > MAC (TDK AD-X normal bias tape, with Dolby on) > Sony TC-D5M > Soundblaster > Soundforge >… [5]. Also: A tape-flip mistake in He's Gone left about fifty seconds blank, which was patched using the soundboard [5]
- **gd1984-03-31.177920.schoeps.mk4.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; Schoeps MK4 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII 90) [6]. Also: Schoeps source from Scott Wiseman's cassettes; Sennheiser 421 patches fill gaps in Althea, He's Gone and Not Fade Away [6]
- **gd84-03-31.sbd.nawrocki.14078.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by MC > DAT > CDR > EAC > Cool Edit Pro 2.0* > CDWave > mkwACT by Doug Nawrocki, via Vojo; source: SBD > MC [12]. Also: Tape was passed on by an attendee right after he returned from the March show [18]
- **gd84-03-31.sbd.lai.2576.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [14]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-04-01 Marin County Veterans Auditorium, San Rafael, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-04-01-marin-county-veterans-auditorium-san-rafael-ca-usa/) [28]
